Title: Checkout error taxonomy and instrumentation
Description: Make checkout failures measurable by normalizing reason codes and emitting checkout_error events
Acceptance Criteria: Every checkout failure has a reason code; admin shows ranked error causes for last 7 days

Title: Checkout mobile layout optimization
Description: Reduce mobile drop-off by improving spacing stacking and CTA visibility
Acceptance Criteria: No clipped content or overlapping controls on tested widths; mobile completion improves from Week 1 baseline

Title: Fee breakdown readability pass
Description: Improve confidence and comprehension in pricing summary with clearer label hierarchy
Acceptance Criteria: Users identify net amount quickly in usability pass; no terminology mismatch between checkout and admin

Title: Projection copy and assumption consistency audit
Description: Ensure scenario-based return language and assumption controls are consistent across surfaces
Acceptance Criteria: No fixed-return language remains; assumption help text matches across pages

Title: CTA hierarchy refactor on fund/dashboard mobile
Description: De-crowd action controls by grouping secondary actions and preserving primary action clarity
Acceptance Criteria: Primary action is always obvious; tap misfires reduced in QA walkthrough

Title: UX copy standardization (errors + confirmations)
Description: Standardize confirmation and error language and remove technical backend phrasing
Acceptance Criteria: Copy review passes for touched flows; no raw backend error strings shown to end users

Title: Stripe checkout preflight endpoint
Description: Add preflight validation to prevent avoidable checkout session failures
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid requests fail preflight instead of checkout creation; frontend shows specific remediation message

Title: Baseline conversion dashboard and report
Description: Publish weekly conversion scorecard with starts completes failure reasons and device split
Acceptance Criteria: Week 2 scorecard published and repeatable; rates tie back to tracked events
